name: Jamestown
questions: BuyerIQ puts the address inside a mapped high-noise zone: is that the M7, the R445 (old N7) or something else, and how far is the house from it?
Can you send a site map of the half acre showing the boundaries, the tennis court and the workshop? How much open lawn is left, and is the boundary fenced or walled all round (we have two dogs)?
What is the BER certificate number and the kWh/m²/yr figure? How old are the oil boiler and tank, and what did heating cost last year?
How old is the septic tank and is it registered and inspected? Can you share a recent well-water test, and has the house been tested for radon?
BuyerIQ shows 10 planning applications within 1 km, one an active build: do you know what is being built next to Jamestown?

ai.why: Three ground-floor bedrooms and a bathroom in 170 m², a big workshop and Monasterevin's 26-a-day Heuston trains 4.5 km away, at €450k. Only half an acre (part tennis court), a flagged noise zone, and the nearest secondary is a DEIS school with weak progression figures.

electricity.detail: Connected; electricity is listed under services, and the workshop has power.

water.detail: Private well, stated in the listing; ask for a water test.

sewer.detail: Septic tank, stated in the listing; ask its age, registration and condition.

internet.detail: Fibre broadband, stated in the listing's services; BuyerIQ shows '101 Mb full fibre' at this address. Confirm the provider by Eircode.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: Bedrooms 1 (4.10 × 4.14 m), 2 (2.90 × 3.50 m) and 3 (3.50 × 2.50 m) are on the ground floor, with a 3.60 × 1.80 m bathroom (bath and shower).

bedsNote: Three bedrooms on the ground floor; two upstairs (one en suite) plus a 4.50 × 2.80 m office
heating: Dual oil-fired central heating, with a solid-fuel Grant back boiler
tagline: A 1984 five-bed dormer with three bedrooms downstairs, a large workshop and a tennis court on half an acre, about 4.5 km southwest of Monasterevin and its Dublin trains.

pros.text: Three ground-floor bedrooms and a bathroom
pros.detail: Bedrooms 1–3 (17, 10 and 9 m²) and a bath-and-shower room are downstairs, so Gabor's parents need not climb stairs.
Monasterevin station is about 4.5 km by the listing's count, with about 26 weekday trains to Heuston taking 43–60 minutes.
About €2,650/m² for 170 m²; stamp duty about €4,500.

pros.text: 170 m² with a big kitchen and an office
pros.detail: Kitchen 6.13 × 4.14 m, sitting room 4.70 × 3.50 m, a 4.80 × 5.60 m en-suite main bedroom and a 4.50 × 2.80 m office upstairs.
7.25 × 13.65 m (about 99 m²) with electricity: room for bikes, a dog room or a studio.

pros.text: Portlaoise ED with paediatrics about 20–25 minutes
pros.detail: Midland Regional Portlaoise is about 15 km straight-line; its ED extension opened in May 2026 with paediatric resus, triage and isolation rooms.
Electric gates, a tarmac drive and mature trees round the boundary; fibre broadband is listed (BuyerIQ: 101 Mb full fibre) and no mapped flood zone.

cons.text: Only half an acre, partly tennis court
cons.detail: About 0.2 ha, half the 1-acre target; a full tennis court (roughly 600 m²) and the 99 m² workshop take a good share of it.
BuyerIQ flags the address as inside a mapped busy-road, rail or flight noise zone; the source (M7 or the R445, the old N7) is not identified.
St Paul's Monasterevin (mixed, DEIS, about 4 km) sent 55% to third level in 2017 and Coláiste Íosagáin Portarlington 60–76%; Newbridge College (99%, fee-paying) is about 21 km straight-line.
No kWh figure given (C2 is 175–200 kWh/m²/yr); a heat pump and insulation would be a rough €30–50k before grants.
Ask for a water test and the tank's age and registration, especially for rental use.

cons.text: Building activity nearby; setting not seen from above
cons.detail: BuyerIQ shows 10 planning applications within 1 km, one an active build; no satellite check yet (no browser), only the listing's 'peaceful rural setting' and 'enclosed by mature trees'.
Rath Mixed NS (196 pupils, 96 boys, not DEIS) is 2.6 km away, but no evaluation report beyond a 2021 Covid-safety check could be read.

trips.title: Rath Mixed NS
candidates: Rath National School, Rath, Ballybrittas, Co. Laois R32 Y510
trips.note: Mixed, Catholic, 196 pupils (96 boys), not DEIS, roll 13741Q; 2.6 km by Daft's count. Scoil Naomh Eoin, Killenard is 3.2 km.

rating.basis: Mixed, not DEIS, steady enrolment near 200; the only report found is a 2021 Covid-safety (SSPS) check, with no whole-school evaluation readable.

trips.label: School run
trips.title: St Paul's Secondary School, Monasterevin
candidates: St Paul's Secondary School, Moore Abbey, Monasterevin, Co. Kildare W34 F576
trips.note: Mixed (424 boys, 419 girls), Catholic, DEIS, new campus at Moore Abbey; about 4 km.

rating.basis: 55% progression to third level in the 2017 Irish Independent table (40 students) and DEIS status; the move to a new 850-place building may have changed this, but no newer figure was found.

trips.label: The better school
trips.title: Newbridge College
trips.note: Mixed, Dominican, fee-paying; about 21 km straight-line. Coláiste Íosagáin, Portarlington (mixed, 60–76% to third level in 2017–18) is closer at about 7 km.

rating.basis: 99% progression to third level in the 2017 Kildare feeder table (Leinster Leader); fee-paying.

trips.note: Ballybrittas has a pub and a service station about 2 km away; Monasterevin, about 4.5 km, has the fuller choice. The page keeps the fastest.

trips.title: Supermarket in Monasterevin or Portarlington
trips.note: Monasterevin's and Portarlington's supermarkets (stores unconfirmed); Lidl has reportedly bought the old St Paul's site on Monasterevin's Main Street.

trips.note: The Heritage resort in Killenard, about 5 km, or the Hazel Hotel in Monasterevin; check opening hours.

trips.note: 24-hour ED that takes children; its extension with paediatric resus and isolation rooms opened in May 2026. Naas ED is adults (16+) only.

trips.note: Monasterevin, about 4.5 km: shops, pharmacies, cafés and the station; Portarlington and Portlaoise for more.
